slots.image_prompt: Full-frame dark tech futuristic background, deep near-black base with a sweeping sky-blue (#2196F3) to cyan (#00BCD4) gradient glow emanating from center. A luminous wireframe grid receding into perspective with subtle particle trails streaming diagonally across the canvas. Soft volumetric light rays pierce through faint haze. Ambient depth with bokeh light points scattered in the distance. Cinematic wide composition, no text, no logos, pure atmospheric mood imagery for a tech presentation cover.

Vertical dark-themed decorative panel, deep navy-black background with cascading streams of luminous sky-blue (#2196F3) and cyan (#00BCD4) abstract character glyphs and code-like symbols flowing downward. Thin glowing connection lines and nodes link scattered data points like a constellation map. Soft radial glow at the center creates a sense of digital depth. Minimalist, futuristic, atmospheric, no readable text or numbers, pure ambient decoration for a tech presentation.

Dark futuristic section divider background, deep charcoal-black canvas with a large luminous hexagonal frame outlined in glowing sky-blue (#2196F3). Inside the frame, soft radial cyan (#00BCD4) glow radiates outward creating a portal-like depth effect. Subtle geometric circuit patterns and thin wireframe lines drift across the background. The overall mood is cinematic and high-tech, evoking a gateway to a new chapter. No text, no numbers, purely decorative ambient artwork for a presentation section header.

Ultra-wide panoramic dark background with a horizontal flowing energy ribbon stretching across the entire frame, rendered in deep sky-blue (#2196F3) transitioning to cyan (#00BCD4). Glowing spherical nodes pulse along the ribbon at irregular intervals, each emitting a soft halo of light. Faint vertical light beams rise from select nodes like milestones. The background is near-black with subtle starfield particles. Futuristic, sleek, atmospheric, no text or labels, designed as a decorative backdrop for a timeline content page.

Small square dark decorative element, deep navy-black background with clusters of luminous sky-blue (#2196F3) abstract code glyphs and binary-like characters swirling in a vortex pattern. Thin cyan (#00BCD4) connection lines weave between the symbols, forming a delicate web. Soft glow emanates from the center with a vignette darkening the edges. Minimalist, futuristic, atmospheric, no readable text, designed as a corner accent decoration.

Square dark-themed decorative artwork, near-black background divided into four quadrants by thin luminous sky-blue (#2196F3) dividing lines. At the very center, an intensely bright cyan (#00BCD4) glowing node radiates light in all four directions with connecting lines reaching toward each quadrant corner. Each quadrant contains a soft halo of light and faint geometric patterns. The composition evokes convergence and unity. Futuristic, balanced, symmetrical, no text, pure decorative ambient imagery.

Full-frame dark tech background, deep near-black canvas overlaid with an extremely fine and dense wireframe grid in muted sky-blue (#2196F3) at low opacity. A radial gradient glow in cyan (#00BCD4) emanates from the lower-center area, softly illuminating the grid lines. Subtle floating particles drift across the space like digital dust. The overall feel is minimalist, clean, and high-tech, designed as a subtle decorative backdrop for a content slide.

Wide dark tech-themed background with three vertical columns of upward-flowing light particles, rendered in sky-blue (#2196F3) and cyan (#00BCD4). Each column rises from a glowing base at the bottom and disperses into a soft halo near the top, like digital pillars of data ascending. Between the columns, faint horizontal connection lines suggest interconnection. The background is deep near-black with subtle starfield texture. Futuristic, dynamic, atmospheric, no text or numbers, designed as a decorative backdrop for a section header.

Tall vertical dark decorative panel, deep navy-black background with a massive luminous sky-blue (#2196F3) ornamental quotation mark shape rendered as flowing light, occupying the upper portion. Below it, thin vertical lines of glowing cyan (#00BCD4) accent strokes descend gracefully like digital rain. Soft radial glow emanates from behind the quotation mark creating depth. The mood is elegant, contemplative, and futuristic, no readable text, designed as a decorative accent element for a quote-focused content page.

Dark futuristic network visualization, deep near-black canvas with a bright cyan (#00BCD4) central node radiating luminous connection lines outward to approximately twelve smaller satellite nodes scattered across the frame. Each connection line pulses with sky-blue (#2196F3) energy, and the satellite nodes vary in size and glow intensity. The composition evokes a decentralized communication network spreading from a single source. Subtle background starfield particles add depth. Abstract, metaphorical, atmospheric, no text or labels, representing the concept of a connected community.

Ultra-wide horizontal dark background with five parallel curved light trails flowing from left to right, rendered in glowing sky-blue (#2196F3) with cyan (#00BCD4) highlights. Each trail starts as a thin wisp on the left side and gradually intensifies as it curves inward toward a single brilliant convergence point near the right-center of the frame. The convergence point emits a powerful radial glow. The deep near-black background features subtle particle dust and faint grid texture. Futuristic, dynamic, atmospheric, no text, designed as a decorative backdrop for a multi-path content page.

Full-frame dark cinematic background for a presentation finale, deep near-black canvas with an intense sky-blue (#2196F3) to cyan (#00BCD4) radial glow emanating from the exact center and fading smoothly outward into darkness. Soft volumetric light rays fan out from the center like a rising sun of digital light. Fine particles drift slowly across the canvas, catching the glow. The mood is hopeful, monumental, and uplifting, evoking a sense of closure and possibility. No text, pure atmospheric ambient imagery.

Wide dark background featuring thousands of luminous sky-blue (#2196F3) and cyan (#00BCD4) particles streaming from all four edges of the frame and converging toward the center point. The particles leave faint motion-trail streaks as they travel inward, creating a sense of gravitational pull. The center area is a soft bright glow where all streams meet. The surrounding space is deep near-black with sparse ambient particles. Futuristic, dynamic, energetic, atmospheric, no text, designed as a decorative closing visual.
